description: Three-family weak-signal benchmark with 100 base signals. Frequency positions are deterministically mapped into the low-frequency 0.15-1.9 MHz region. Family B uses deterministic same-signal cross-frequency copies within the same low-frequency region. Periods are stratified to 75% short (12-96 records) and 25% long (120-900 records), all below 1000 records. Duration fractions provide at least ten cycles on the 43794-record largest complete CE4 2C test file. Duty cycles remain below 0.75 with 30% in the low-duty (<0.30) regime.
